chunks: And al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd narrated that, from Muḥammad ibn Sinān, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Yaḥyā al-Kāhilī and al-Ḥusayn ibn al-Mukhtār, from Abī ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام, who said:
"The proper amount of camphor is four mithqāls."

key_terms.الْكَافُورِ: camphor used in preparing the deceased

ai.seo_question: What is the prescribed amount of camphor for preparing the deceased in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states the proper quantity of camphor to be used, specifying it as four mithqāls. It relates to funerary jurisprudence and the prescribed measures observed in preparing the deceased.
